title_protection.quote: "Licensed contractor" means a contractor who is licensed by the Board to provide heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services, but does not include a licensed apprentice or licensed journeyman.

scope_protection.quote: "Journeyman license" means a license issued by the Board to provide heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, and refrigeration services while under the direction and control of a licensed contractor.

definition_quote.value: "Provide heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services" means to install, maintain, alter, remodel, or repair heating systems, cooling systems, refrigeration systems, ventilation systems, or hydronic systems.

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: Before any license or permit may be issued under this article to an employer to engage in an activity in which the employer may employ a covered employee, as defined in § 9-101 of the Labor and Employment Article, the employer shall file with the issuing authority: (1) A certificate of compliance with the Maryland Workers' Compensation Act; or (2) The number of a workers' compensation insurance policy or binder.

scope__system_components_included.quote: "Self-contained appliance" means a heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration device that is designed and manufactured: (1) with its component parts contained within a single chassis

"Provide heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services" means to install, maintain, alter, remodel, or repair heating systems, cooling systems, refrigeration systems, ventilation systems, or hydronic systems.
"Hydronic system" means a heating and cooling system using liquids or steam to transmit or remove heat.
"Cooling system" means a system in which heat is removed from air, surrounding surfaces, or both. (2) "Cooling system" includes an air-conditioning system.

scope__qualifier_license_type_required.item: Certified Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Contractor License

scope__qualifier_license_type_required.quote: "Master license" means a license issued by the Board to provide heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, or refrigeration services.

"Master restricted license" means a license issued by the Board to provide services in only one of the following areas: (1) heating - forced air systems; (2) heating - hydronic systems; (3) ventilation; (4) air-conditioning; or (5) refrigeration.
